articles.title: Rahm Emanuel Says Trump Is Playing Into China’s Hands
articles.summary: Former US Ambassador to Japan Rahm Emanuel tells Bloomberg This Weekend that he is seriously considering a 2028 presidential run as he lays out an economic vision focused on reforming capitalism, combating corruption and strengthening the middle class. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Emanuel also criticizes President Donald Trump’s approach to China and Russia, arguing that the US should work more closely with allies to counter Beijing and protect American economic and national security interests.  (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Trump’s Asia Trip Leaves Key Issues Unresolved
articles.summary: ABC News State Department reporter Shannon Kingston tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Russia’s increasingly provocative actions near NATO countries are complicating President Donald Trump’s push for a negotiated end to the war in Ukraine, while Moscow remains publicly defiant. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kingston says Trump’s Asia trip produced few concrete results and puts greater pressure on the upcoming G20 meetings to deliver progress on China, trade and other unresolved diplomatic issues. (Source: Bloomberg)
